chapter_outcomes: read a longer text printed in the question paper and make brief notes under a number of supplied headings
write a paragraph-length summary (of no more than 100 words) about an aspect or aspects of the text using own words as far as possible

use a range of grammatical structures and vocabulary accurately and effectively
show control of punctuation and spelling
